investigator.method: Bounded Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC refinement probe: single unauthenticated GET of the official_programme_url, no browser/auth/retries; music-relevance assessed only from the retrieved content.

probe_history.reason: The single GET confirmed venue identity (schema.org Organization "Southlands Arts Centre", operated by "Yiewsley and West Drayton Arts Council", matching the reported address) but the page’s own "Our Events" section contains no embedded event listing — it only links to a separate /events/ calendar page and a past-events gallery, neither of which was fetched under the one-GET-per-venue bound. No heading, card, or structured-data fragment anywhere in this retrieved page names any specific current or future event, musical or otherwise, so music relevance cannot be honestly assessed from this probe alone.

reasons: Identity is proven, but the single retained Level-1 probe of the given official_programme_url did not expose any current/future event content — the real listing lives on a separate /events/ page not covered by this bounded probe.
